lado_card.texto: Templates, hook, headless loop, and measurement. Every command in the lessons comes from it, in the 10/18/2026 version.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · LOOP-R Engineering Track, course 2 of 6 · eventos.inema.pro/loop-r-engenharia · execucao-longa kit on GitHub · inema.club

inicio.kicker: LOOP-R Engineering Track · course 2 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Long runs: the agent works for hours and the test decides when it's done
inicio.lead: Seven state files, a goal.md that can't be met by a shortcut, a hook that watches the context and the cache, a handoff you can check, a headless loop with caps, and measurement of every session. All with the open execucao-longa kit and real terminal output.
inicio.capa_alt: Engineering workbench at night with a terminal, an instrument panel, and a cable in a loop.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order you build them: folder and goal, context and cache, handoff, headless loop, measurement, and a full run.

itens: People who already use Claude Code or Codex in the terminal and want to leave a task running for hours.
People who have seen the agent say "done" with a deleted test, or forget what it did after a compaction.
People who need to run an agent in cron or systemd without freezing the machine or wasting the quota.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Create the longrun/ folder and write command → output criteria that cover function, regression, and limit.
Turn on the context band hook and know when to compact, write a handoff, or open a new session.
Run loop-longrun.sh with flock, timeout, MemoryMax, and protected tests, first with a fake agent.
Measure the session, the cost of resuming, and find old decisions with recall.
Linux or macOS with git, Python 3, and pytest; on Linux, user systemd for MemoryMax and the timers.
Claude Code or Codex installed and signed in through your subscription. The rehearsal exercises don't use up quota.
Recommended: course 0 (Base) for the done criterion scale and course 1 (Verification) for evaluators.
